# Asterisk iPhone Bluetooth Gateway Lab

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Borisych-C/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab)
- [Cases](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/issues.json)
- [Call disconnects immediately on answer](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/sco-false-hangup.html)
- [One-way audio despite successful Bluetooth writes](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/sco-host-packet-size.html)
- [RTP arrives but outgoing Bluetooth audio stops intermittently](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/rtp-source-reset.html)
- [iPhone Bluetooth Show Notifications switch is missing](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/iphone-map-permission.html)
- [Previously delivered SMS appears again after reconnect](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/iphone-map-metadata.html)
- [PushMessage completes but recipient has no SMS](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/iphone-map-outgoing.html)
- [SMS goes to a different number from the contact card](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/linphone-contact-selection.html)
- [invalid-address even when MESSAGE(to) is correct](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/agi-field-truncation.html)
- [Registered client immediately receives 488 or cannot establish media](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/linphone-srtp-profile.html)
- [Caller number exists in SIP but is not displayed](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/caller-id-whitespace.html)
- [Call connects with missing audio or does not hang up](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/nat-rtp-range.html)
- [Public name points to unavailable IPv6](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/dns-stale-ipv6.html)
- [Russian SIP MESSAGE is mojibake despite Russian menus](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/t780p-character-map.html)
- [SIP URI pasted into search fails or uses unexpected transport](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/linphone-uri-input.html)
- [Seven service messages appear at once after one SMS](https://borisych-c.github.io/asterisk-iphone-bluetooth-gateway-lab/cases/notification-burst.html)
